_doc: Paint, refutation round 3 (2026-11-23), after round 2's fix, on 20 fresh boxes, ALL read (refute.py r3: junctions at s 325, 618, 1034, 1740, 2200, 2560, 3400, 4130, 4536, 5919; mid-block at s 60, 560, 1350, 2260, 2900, 3650, 4250, 5050, 5700, 6150). Counts by eye on the overlays, approximate; the 'detected' grade could not be judged in the two boxes that lie under a tower's shadow in 2022 (j2200, m2260: most items there are 2020 fills) and they are left out of its count.

causes_and_fixes: wandering 'lines' (a shadow's stepped edge, a seam, a kerb's curve): a solid line that leaves its own cubic fit by 0.12 m rms or 0.35 m is graded detected (paint_lap.py)
paint on bright concrete (Stout St): NOT fixed. The reader's pavement test is 'dark'; Stout's dashes are declared unread in SURVEY.md
rail slab edges and concrete crossing borders on Stout: NOT fixed; they are bright bands on the roadway and the reader cannot tell them from paint
